answer: In an agent market forecasting glacier melt and winds along a ridge, whether a zephyr or a gale, voting power is proportional to tokens locked in escrow, not the number of accounts. Splitting 100 tokens among a thousand fake agents gives no more influence than locking them in one account. To gain more power, an attacker must acquire and immobilize more tokens, paying their purchase price and losing access to that capital during the lockup.
